title: T4 Prior-Artifact Schema Resolution
purpose: Resolve the actual JSON schema of the prior T9/T8 artifacts required by OP-011 before writing artifact-dependent validation logic.

purpose.value: Validate the actual contents and semantics of native T2-T7 candidate outputs before empirical T9 calibration/evaluation.

reason.value: OP-003 identified no native prediction/probability artifact suitable for T9 acceptance.

T2.value: Accepted only as native categorical Priority probability output if probability values and target alignment pass.

T3.value: No accepted native output; no synthetic probability/confidence may be created.

T4.value: Accepted as native candidate-space ranking; scores are not assumed to be universal probabilities.

T5.value: Accepted as native duplicate probability output with frozen binary target and group-aware structure.

T6.value: Accepted as query-level retrieval/ranking evidence only; not ordinary binary confidence.

T7.value: Accepted as native survival/time-to-event output with duration/event and censoring semantics preserved.

t4_semantic_candidates.value: Accepted as native candidate-space ranking; scores are not assumed to be universal probabilities.

title.value: Accepted Native Output Population & Semantics Lock

purpose.value: Freeze the empirical T9 output boundary and task-specific semantics before calibration/evaluation procedures are selected or fitted.

reason.value: Existing T2 prediction artifacts contain hard predictions but no native T2_probability_P1 through T2_probability_P5 probability artifact was found within the T2 evidence boundary.
OP-003 identified no native prediction/probability artifact suitable for the T9 acceptance boundary.

calibration_boundary.value: Any later confidence/calibration formulation must be defined specifically for the T4 ranking/candidate space and must not invent a universal probability.
Task-specific duplicate-probability calibration may proceed using the accepted native development/validation output under the established T5 structure.
Any later T6 confidence formulation must be defined around native query-level retrieval/ranking semantics rather than ordinary binary probability calibration.
Later T7 calibration must retain survival semantics and right censoring.

closure_statement.value: The T9 empirical boundary is frozen at the task-specific native-output level. T5 is the currently accepted native probability output. T4 and T6 remain native ranking quantities. T7 remains native survival/time-to-event output. T2 probability calibration is unavailable because no native probability artifact exists. T3 has no accepted native prediction artifact. No universal confidence or risk score is established.

OP-004.value: Accepted as native candidate-space ranking; scores are not assumed to be universal probabilities.

interpretation_boundary: This operation only inspects existing JSON artifacts.
No model fitting or prediction generation is performed.
No calibration or probability generation is performed.
No target, threshold, confidence, or risk construct is created.
The discovered schema must be used to construct the corrected OP-011 validator.
next_operation: Use the resolved artifact schema to construct the corrected T9 MOD-037 OP-011 T4 native ranking evaluation and calibration-readiness audit.
